learning_goal: Establish baseline empirical knowledge and mechanisms of human memory (encoding, storage, retrieval, consolidation, amnesia, and enhancement) to support cognitive agent reasoning.
expected_capabilities: Distinguish between sensory memory, short-term/working memory, and long-term memory systems.
Recall neural substrates of memory systems including amygdala, hippocampus, cerebellum, and prefrontal cortex.
Recognize memory distortions, forgetting curves, and amnesia distinctions (retrograde vs anterograde).
Identify evidence-based memory enhancement techniques (elaborative rehearsal, chunking, spacing effect).
forbidden_outputs: Promotion of proposed notes to ACTIVE without explicit human attestation
Fabricated citations or quotes not identical to source text
Unattributed assertions outside of chapter coverage
